topic: Repository-wide audit of what still needs fixing, aligning, or better integrating with system-spec-kit, the spec-folder workflow and continuity runtime

focus: Commands under .opencode/commands that write files/state without routing through Gate 3, create.sh, validate.sh, or the continuity writer
noveltyJustification: First pass; full survey of the command surface against spec-kit's validation/continuity layer is entirely new to this packet.

ruledOut.reason: Each routes through its own owning skill pipeline (sk-doc etc.), matching CLAUDE.md's documented routing split

focus: Skills/agents whose SKILL.md or agent contract still describe retired surfaces (memory MCP, scripts/ paths, memory/ paths, @spec-kit/scripts, /memory:* commands)
noveltyJustification: Confirms an entire angle is clean (high-value negative knowledge) but yields no actionable fix; one sub-check was a self-corrected false positive.

ruledOut.reason: Codex agents use .toml extension not .md; 12/12 parity confirmed

focus: Hook registrations across .claude/.codex/.cursor/.devin/.pi/opencode.json vs runtime/dist/hooks adapters; CI workflows vs invoked scripts
noveltyJustification: One genuine actionable gap (mkHookDrift asymmetry) plus a fully verified-clean CI mapping and a resolved false positive on the Pi dist exclusion.

ruledOut.reason: Pi hooks load .ts sources directly via .pi/extensions symlinks by design; tsconfig explicitly excludes hooks/pi/**

focus: Across 15+ sampled spec packets, do generated metadata/status fields/phase maps contradict the documents
noveltyJustification: Repo-wide quantified structural defect (127/2707 packets, 4.7%) with root cause confirmed directly in the validator's own source comments; highest-confidence finding of the run so far.

ruledOut.approach: 000-release missing Status table row as a template defect
ruledOut.reason: Uses a valid distinct blockquote-status template for its release-capture purpose

focus: Helpers duplicated across skills that spec-kit's runtime already exports via @spec-kit/runtime/api or CLI utilities
noveltyJustification: Reframes the angle's premise (no cross-skill export surface exists at all) with direct README evidence, then grounds two concrete duplication instances in that corrected context.

ruledOut.approach: shared/paths.ts as the canonical path-containment utility
ruledOut.reason: Resolves database directories, unrelated to path containment

focus: Retrieval coverage gaps: documents the trigger index and ripgrep conventions cannot reach, exclusion-list disagreements, missing trigger phrases
noveltyJustification: Fully root-caused, reproducible, critical-severity infrastructure bug in the core retrieval mechanism, confirmed via source arithmetic and three cross-validated artifacts. Highest-confidence and highest-impact finding of the run.

focus: Validation rule gaps: defects the review passes found by hand that no validate.sh rule would have caught, and which rule would
noveltyJustification: Synthesis pass mapping already-found defects (F1-1,F4-1,F4-4,F6-1) against the full 25-rule inventory; new structural understanding in the rule-by-rule mapping and the ownership-seam framing, not fresh discovery.

focus: README and feature-catalog accuracy for the spec-kit skill against the code that exists today
noveltyJustification: Precisely quantified, five-times-repeated documentation defect traced to its exact authoritative source file (37 actual vs 46 claimed rules), plus a clean verification pass on adjacent claims.

ruledOut.approach: feature-catalog.md aggregate feature count as a falsifiable claim
ruledOut.reason: No aggregate count stated anywhere in the document

focus: Deep-loop integration seams: how fanout-run, deep-review/deep-research leaves, and the reducer write spec packets vs spec-kit's metadata generators
noveltyJustification: Extends the F4-4 staleness pattern to packet-level generated metadata, grounded in a live self-referential timestamp gap from this very lineage's own target packet.

ruledOut.approach: children_ids pollution from research/review local-owner folders

focus: Ranked, deduplicated synthesis of every finding from iterations 1-9 with owner surface, fix sketch, and verification command
noveltyJustification: Pure synthesis of prior findings into a ranked, deduplicated, cross-referenced table; the ranking and consolidation is the deliverable, not new evidence.
